title: PresentationPlan
description: Stage B step 1 output: ordered slide plan from a confirmed FrameworkObject. Technical plan section 12.

schema_version.description: Contract version for codegen and forward compatibility (AT-6).

title.description: Presentation title, typically derived from the opportunity.

slides.description: Ordered planned slides. Normal decks target 8-15 slides (section 12).

LayoutId.description: Must match a layout in layout_registry.json (section 13.1).

FrameworkReference.description: Pointer to FrameworkObject content, e.g. opportunity, chapter_1, chapter_10.

order.description: 1-based slide sequence in the final deck.

purpose.description: Why this slide exists, e.g. cover, context, timeline.

frameworkReferences.description: FrameworkObject fields/chapters this slide draws from.
